programme.title: Der Glücksbringer
programme.desc: Leider fängt das Liebesleben für den kleinen Charlie mit einem Desaster an. Als der 10-Jährige sich beim Flaschendrehen weigert, ein Mädchen zu küssen, belegt ihn die Abgewiesene mit einem Fluch: Er werde fortan Pech in der Liebe haben! So soll es kommen ... Jahre später hat der erfolgreiche Zahnarzt immer noch nicht die Richtige gefunden. Seine Ex-Freundinnen allerdings treffen alle den Mann fürs Leben – und zwar immer nach ihrem Date mit Charlie! Als das bekannt wird, stehen die Mädels auf der Suche nach Mr. Right Schlange für einen Quickie beim „Glücksbringer“. Nicht schlecht, denkt Charlie, kann man mitnehmen – bis er die tollpatschige Cam kennen lernt, eine Pinguin-Spezialistin. Als sich zwischen ihnen vorsichtig eine Liebesgeschichte anbahnt, muss Charlie den Bann brechen und den Fluch loswerden, ehe er sein Traumgirl an den nächsten verliert!

programme.title: Joe Dreck
programme.desc: Im Alter von acht Jahren wird Dummkopf Joe Dirt bei einem Ausflug zum Grand Canyon von seinen Eltern ausgesetzt. Joe ist sich der grausamen Wahrheit jedoch nicht bewußt und geht davon aus, er wäre unglücklicherweise verloren gegangen. Es folgt eine lange, rastlose Suche nach seinen Erzeugern bei der Joe so manches Abenteuer erlebt und viele skurile und interessante Personen kennenlernt.

programme.title: Joe Dreck 2: Beautiful Loser
programme.desc: In dieser Fortsetzung des Kultfilms Joe Dreck von 2001 spielt David Spade wieder den glücklosen Rock ‘n' Roll-Fan und White-Trash-Helden mit der Vokuhila-Frisur. Diesmal führt ihn seine epische Reise durch die jüngere Vergangenheit, das Herz von Amerika und durch seinen eigenen Verstand, um zurück zu seinen Lieben zu kommen.

programme.title: The Quick and the Dead
programme.desc: Einmal im Jahr will der Tyrann seine Feinde sehen. John Herod (Gene Hackman), der skrupellose Herrscher über ein kleines Städtchen im Wilden Westen, stellt sich im öffentlichen Schießwettbewerb seinen Herausforderern. Preisgeld: 100.000 Dollar! In zahllosen Duellen bringen sich die Revolverhelden gegenseitig um. Doch den heißesten Coup führt die unbekannte Schöne (Sharon Stone). Sie raucht, sie trinkt, sie trifft - und kennt offensichtlich nur ein Ziel: das Duell mit Herod...

programme.title: Jesse Stone: No Remorse
programme.desc: Tom Selleck nimmt erneut seine Rolle als Jesse Stone ein, dem schmerzgeplagten und unerbittlichen früheren Polizeichef der Kleinstadt Paradise, Massachusetts. Während seines selbstgewählten Exils nach seiner Entlassung aus dem Polizeidienst holt eine Serie zusammenhängender Morde im nahen Boston Stone aus seiner Untätigkeit zurück. Nicht lange, und er ist auf einer Spur, die ihn zu niemand geringerem als dem berüchtigtsten Gangster der Stadt führt, zu Gino Fish (WILLIAM SADLER). Basierend auf den Figuren aus den Jesse Stone-Romanen des Bestsellerautors Robert B. Parker. Mit WILLIAM DEVANE und KATHY BAKER. Jesse Stone: NO REMORSE ist eine Reise ins Paradies, die sie nicht verpassen dürfen!

programme.title: American Underdog
programme.desc: Der Film basiert auf der wahren Geschichte von Kurt Warner (Zachary Levi), der vom einfachen Supermarktangestellten zum zweimaligen NFL MVP, Super Bowl Champion und Hall of Fame Quarterback wurde. Im Mittelpunkt des Films stehen Warners einzigartige Geschichte über die Jahre der Herausforderungen und Rückschläge, die seine Ambitionen, NFL-Spieler zu werden, hätten zunichtemachen können.

programme.title: The Anderson Tapes
programme.desc: Ein Gewohnheitsverbrecher möchte direkt nach der Entlassung aus dem Gefängnis einen großen Coup durchziehen und wendet sich an ein Syndikat, das ihm einen massiven Raubzug finanzieren soll. Er hat vor, ein schickes East Side New York Apartment-Gebäude auszurauben. Er schart eine Truppe erstklassiger Diebe um sich und arbeitet an seinem geplanten Coup, ist sich dabei aber nicht bewusst, dass seine Aktionen alle aufgezeichnet werden.

programme.title: Der Mann hinter der Maske
programme.desc: Der gerissenste Söldner der British East India Company, Will Reynolds, wurde reingelegt und ist nun auf der Flucht durch die amerikanischen Kolonien. Beim Versuch, sich zu rehabilitieren und die Frau zurückzugewinnen, die er so oft belogen hat, schlüpft Will in eine neue Identität, um seinen früheren Arbeitgeber zu täuschen. Während seine Vergangenheit ihn einholt, muss Will irgendwie das Vertrauen seiner geliebten Charlotte - und auch das von Ben Franklin – gewinnen, während er gleichzeitig eine Verschwörung historischen Ausmaßes aufdecken will.

programme.title: Sheena
programme.desc: Nach dem Tod eines weißen Forscher-Ehepaars in Afrika nehmen die Eingeborenen dessen zweijährige Tochter Sheena bei sich auf. Die Kleine wächst unter großer Verehrung zu einer schönen Frau heran, der sogar die wilden Tiere gehorchen. Als der TV-Produzent Vic Casey unversehens in eine politische Intrige gerät und den Anschlag auf den König des Stammes filmt, verlieben sich beide ineinander und kämpfen nun gemeinsam gegen den Königsmörder und dessen Söldner-Armee.

programme.title: Wyatt Earp's Revenge
programme.desc: Der Film basiert auf einer wahren Geschichte und sieht einen gealterten Wyatt Earp im Mittelpunkt, der sich mit einem Reporter zusammensetzt und ihm von dem Ritt berichtet, der ihn einst zur Legende machte, als der junge Marshall zusammen mit seinen Helfern den Banditen jagte, der seine große Liebe ermordete.

programme.title: Die Tiefe
programme.desc: Ein erregender Abenteuer-Film des Bestseller-Autors Peter Benchley. Die schöne Traumfrau, Jacqueline Bisset, spielt die Frau von Nick Nolte. Während eines gemeinsamen Tauch-Urlaubes auf den Bermudas entdecken sie einen Schatz besonderer Art: In einem gesunkenen Frachter aus dem 2. Weltkrieg finden sie eine kleine Glasampulle und ein dick verkrustetes Medaillon aus dem Jahre 1714. Damit sind sie sowohl einem gut getarnten Drogenversteck als auch einem Goldschatz aus der Spanierzeit auf der Spur. Ihr Problem: Die Schätze zu bergen und dabei am Leben zu bleiben. Denn die Drogenschieber kämpfen mit allen Mitteln, zu Land wie über und unter Wasser, um ihren verbrecherischen Besitz. Robert Shaw, in der Rolle des abgebrühten Seemannes, steht ihnen in diesem Abenteuer auf Leben und Tod zur Seite.

programme.title: Quarantäne 2: Terminal
programme.desc: In einem heruntergekommenen Mietshaus in Los Angeles ist eine bizarre Seuche ausgebrochen, die niemand überlebte. außer der Seuche selbst. Nun zeigen sich auch an Bord des Fluges 318 erste Symptome. Plötzlich verwandelt die sich ausbreitende Infektion harmlose Passagiere in furchterregende, blutrünstige Killer. Gezwungen, in einem isolierten Terminal notzulanden und umstellt von bewaffneten Regierungstruppen, werden Crew und Passagiere zunehmend verzweifelter. Die einzige Frage lautet nun: Wie weit werden sie gehen, um das eigene Leben zu retten?

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Antarctica - Tales from the End of the World
programme.desc: The Antarctic region is undoubtedly one of the most remote and inhospitable, yet one of the most beautiful landscapes of the world. This documentary takes us on a journey to the stormy isolated islands of the Southern Ocean. Seals, penguins, seabirds and numerous other animals live and breed in this hostile environment and harsh climate. Only by an icebreaker can we reach the remote coasts of the Antarctic continent where Emperor Penguins defy the life-threatening environment of the vast ice desert at the end of the world.

programme.title: mareTV: Majorca
programme.desc: "Cleaning woman island", concrete castles, Ballermann: Mallorca's image is negatively affected in some respects. The documentary explores the charm of the largest Balearic island beyond the hustle and bustle of tourism and Rambazamba. The "real" Mallorca is best explored through real Majorcans: Manolo Barahona, TV fishing expert from the local island broadcaster IB3, faces the most difficult task of the year. The Raor is in season, the most expensive fish on the island. Manolo is supposed to get him first in front of the camera and then in the pan. There's only one catch, the little fish with the piranha teeth just doesn't want to be on TV. In the first months of the year Mallorca turns into a sea of almond blossoms. There are around seven million almond trees on the island, once planted to replace dead vines. But now also the almond trees are threatened. The fire bacterium continues to spread, especially on the large plantations. The farmer Biel Torrens wants to save Mallorca's almond trees and fruit with a small organic plantation and gentle harvesting methods. He shakes the almonds from the tree by hand instead of using a mechanical vibrator.

programme.title: Menorca - Majorca's beautiful sister
programme.desc: Not nearly as crowded as Majorca or Ibiza: Menorca has noticeably fewer visitors than her sister islands and in 1993, was recognised by UNESCO as a biosphere re-serve. Menorca also has its own distinctive charm, with its secluded coves, mighty cliffs, beautiful gardens and ages old towns and villages. Its residents love the is-lands treasures and peculiarities. Forests make up al-most a third of Menorca, complemented by many lush green meadows. Next to tourism, agriculture is a major source of the island's income to the present day. On Menorca, there are several accumulations of enormous megalithic stones. From a global point of view, the up to five-metre-tall "Taulas", whereby the stones are ar-ranged in the shape of a "T", are unique.

programme.title: mareTV: Ibiza - Island of Light
programme.desc: The light of the Balearic island of Ibiza is magical and its trademark: The "Island of Light" is tiny compared to its sister island Mallorca, but offers the most beautiful sunsets in the world. That's what they say. They attract sun worshippers and party people from near and far. To the sounds of the famous "Balearic Sound" they turn night into day. This documentary documents the island in the balancing act between luxury yachts and traditions. Hippie culture, celebrities, pine forests, bays with turquoise water and villages with bright white houses: Ibiza has many faces. Mora (80) and Djin (67) have been drawn to the island for 55 years. They are the uncrowned kings of the hippies. But only love, light, air and laziness, these times are also long gone on Ibiza. Mora knits sexy jerseys for young hippies from morning till night. Djin helps her sell at the famous Las Dalias hippie market and works as a construction worker: chilling and no pension in sight. The virgin Carmen is the patron saint of the sailors. On her day of honour, a mass is celebrated in the port city of Eivissa. Afterwards, fishermen carry the Virgin through the narrow streets of Ibiza City down to the quay. And then Carmen sets sail. Several places on Ibiza claim to offer the most beautiful sunset in the world: In front of Cala de Benirrás, the sun sinks right next to the iconic rock Cap Benat, which the locals awefully call "God's Finger". The typical soft beats over the sea sound from almost all the bays and provide deep relaxation worldwide under the term "Balearic Sound". Some of the famous DJs are jetting around the globe for huge fees. But in the small beach bars, the Chiringuitos, the island sound is celebrated further. On the beach of Cala Salada the Brit Joe Burnley has the command over a troop of mermaids. The ladies squeeze into the tight mermaid costume for the good cause. With great grace they swim towards yachts that are forbidden to anchor on sea grass meadows. Charming but unyielding, they point out the offence to the captain and crew; a creative environmental action to save the endangered Neptune gas, green lung of the sea and habitat for Ibiza's seahorses. The underwater photographer Manu San Felix is also committed to the endangered seahorses. Using a probe, he maps the coastal area around Ibiza and feeds the data into a GPS app. No skipper should be able to say that he didn't even know that his anchor was clawing into Neptune grass. On land, Manu is dedicated to breeding seahorses. His plan: He wants to expose the animals in the Mediterranean to Ibiza and Formentera in order to secure their population. Garages on the beach? Many bays on the island still have Casetas Varadero, boat garages threatened with decay. Fishermen once built them illegally. The picturesque sheds are therefore only tolerated, but may no longer be restored. The 83-year-old Toni Salvado still drives straight out to sea from his garage. He fishes for his own needs and a few friends, he is not allowed to sell his catch.

programme.title: Wild River Rhine
programme.desc: Alluvial forests, roaring waterfalls, steep canyons and sunny slopes flank the river Rhine. The variety of habitats is the reason for the large biodiversity along the stream.There is hardly any other river in Germany that is surrounded by as many myths and legends as the river Rhine. No other river has been the topic of songs, has been painted and travelled equally frequently. Despite this it still seems to be true today what the French poet Victor Hugo once said about this river – the Rhine is a river everybody talks about, nobody explores, everybody visits but no one really knows. The film follows the water against the stream. It starts at the river’s delta in the Netherlands, flows through six countries and ends in the Swiss Alps.

programme.title: Germany's Wild Amazon
programme.desc: As one of Germany’s beauties, the river was the gem of Germanys landscape. But with industrialization it became the country’s hardest working river and like everything that has been overworked, it lost it magnificence and charm. Due to tender love and care, the river is now a reigning example of one of the most successful and outstanding renaturation projects in the country.The film shows never before seen shots of the river now pulsing with life. We will show you the winding river bed, spawning salmon, mating crabs and still-growing anchor ice. You will see dipper birds searching for food under water, kingfishers catching fish, a family life of badgers, foxes and a wide variety of birds. Come and meet the resurrected river Wupper!

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.sub-title: Children of the Sun - Wild Bees
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is a road of mountain passes and India’s access to the roof of the world – the Himalayas. This 475-kilometre long route at the northernmost tip of the Indian subcontinent connects the cities of Manali and Leh at the heart of the Ladakh region. The term “highway” applies quite literally, since the route traverses five of the highest drivable mountain passes in the world – among these the Lohtang La at 3,978 metres above sea level, the Lachulung La at 5,059 metres and the Tanglang La at 5,325 metres. Crossing these passes is a challenge for both vehicle and man. The mountain peaks, still snow-capped even in the depths of summer, wide variety of vegetation and the fantastic and craggy landscape turn any journey into a captivating adventure.

Crossing these passes is a challenge for both vehicle and man. The mountain peaks, still snow-capped even in the depths of summer, wide variety of vegetation and the fantastic and craggy landscape turn any journey into a captivating adventure.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In Bangladesh, the land with the highest density of population in the world (and the highest amount of corruption), the daily struggle to survive is fought everywhere, including the streets. Nowhere do people drive as brutally and recklessly as here. In Bangladesh you drive on the road like others drive with a bumper car: if you need space, you simply ram the car driving next to you. The police only came if there are fatalities. The biggest bottleneck in the transport system is the historical old town of Dhaka. Old Dhaka is a universe of its own, a world of bazaars in which every trade has its own quarter: there are streets of jewelers, sweets makers and fashionable tailors, and the vegetable wholesalers have their warehouses down at the port. The deliveries take place mostly on the river, the Buriganga River, a stinking cesspool. But the sold goods usually leave by land, and the customers also come by the land route – the Nawabpur Road. They generally come in buses or by rickshaw, where too many people are crammed into too little space. The traffic in Dhaka is everyday, normal madness. The film accompanies a rickshaw, a bus and a truck on their dangerous way through the streets of Dhaka and shows how it is possible to survive in what seems to be an incontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The “Adriatic Highway” is one of the most beautiful coastal roads in the world. The “technical masterwork” was built in the 1950s and 60s, at the time of Yugoslavian President Tito. Abounding in curves, the asphalt road stretches from Ankaran in Slovenia to Ulcinj in Montenegro. More than half of the road is in Croatia (659 km) and a quarter in Montenegro (125 km). Shorter segments lead through Slovenia; only nine kilometers are in Bosnia and Herzegovina. For all four countries of the former Yugoslavian Federation, the 1,200-kilometer-long highway remains the main thoroughfare of Adriatic tourism. For many travelers, the highway is the absolute dream road. In dizzying heights, it hugs the steep cliffs lining the Adriatic Sea, winds through coves and bays, gardens and stony fields. Wonderful views of the blue sea, green islands, bizarre cliffs and Mediterranean cities and towns are typical of the highway. But with its numerous curves, the dream road also harbors many dangers.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The air wants to flee the heat, but is too weak. It hovers just above the ground, heavy and weighed down by the oven-like heat. It turns wanly around itself, and tries to cool off by liquefying itself. It vibrates, it oscillates – but there is no escape. This is West Africa in late March. The Harmattan, the hot desert wind of the Sahara, is blowing without respite. It has no pity with the people who live here. Whoever wants to go from one place to another has to travel on roads that hardly deserve this name. They are dusty paths that don’t appear on any map. They are maneuverable only with great effort and for a few months of the year. They are impassable during the rainy season, since they are washed over by the Niger River, one of the mightiest rivers in the world. When it starts to rain, the roads turn into muddy paths. Every journey is a trip into uncertainty.

programme.desc: They run through deserts, through ice and snow, deep into the jungle, along the water and over the mountains. programme.title: mareTV: In Alaska's Fjord World
programme.desc: Gigantic fjords and over 5,000 small islands: In Alaska's south there's a lot of wilderness and little civilization. The region between the capital Juneau and the Canadian border is also known by locals as the "Last Frontier", the last outpost. Michelle Masden, for example, has come to terms with the harsh conditions here. She is the only seaplane pilot in the region. She earns her living with her 65-year-old Beaver: as an air taxi, transport plane and now and then as a rescuer in last necessity. Michelle flies anything and everything: spare parts and food, doctors, hikers and hunters. For the fishermen of southern Alaska she searches for large shoals of fish and guides the captains to the next good catch. Ray Rusaw was a car mechanic by profession, but in his old age he was gripped by gold fever. With a self-built special raft and a highly creative selection of equipment from the DIY store, he sets off in search of the precious metal that his predecessors overlooked two centuries ago. For four years he has been happily obsessively combing through sandbanks and river courses. For Ray, the search for gold has little to do with luck and much to do with meticulous research. He is certain that he has found the perfect spot.

programme.title: Wild Holland - The Living Delta
programme.desc: The film celebrates the diverse natural heritage of the Dutch delta region while sketching the cultural context that has played such a vital part in shaping it. Using cutting edge cinematic techniques ranging from eagle’s eye aerial views to unprecedented underwater scenes, 'Wild Holland - The Living Delta' presents a portrait of this unique wetland area of Europe as never seen before, capturing it in an important moment of change - a time when new life is flooding back into the delta.

programme.title: Fuerteventura: The golden beauty of the Canaries
programme.desc: Fuerteventura, the second largest of the Canary Islands, is located just 120 kilometres off the coast of West Africa. The climate is extremely dry and the struggle for water has always been a major setback. Then, around a century ago, returning US emigrants brought what were then modern wind turbine water pumps from the Aermotor Windmill Company with them to Fuerte-ventura. Today, the environmentally friendly and so-called “Chicago’s”, experience a renaissance. Unfortu-nately, original spare parts in good condition are diffi-cult to come by. When Leocadio Araya Sanchez began planting countless cacti on a barren hillside a few years ago, people thought he was mad. His idea was to make a healthy juice drink from the prickly pears – with great success. But getting the fruit to release its pre-cious superfood juice is no simple task. On an almost daily basis, Marcos Tapia is magnetically attracted to one of the paradisiacal beaches of the island. The 44-year-old is Spanish champion and vice world champion in para-body board surfing. When he was 28. Marcos was involved in a serious motorbike accident and has been paraplegic ever since.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Northern Woods
programme.desc: It is a musical film a a tributeto the Nordic forest: it shows its development from a primeval wood to a cultivated forest. Once populated by wild animals such as wolves, bears, eagles, deer and musk oxen, complex re-enactment-scenes shot by dollies and helicopters vividly depict the colonization of the forest by the Celts and Germans. But as time progressed, the northern forest has on numerous occasions fallen victim to environmental degradation and overexploitation. Several provisions were made to protect this wild beauty. The Helsinki resolution of 1993, which stipulated that the woods be used in a way and in a magnitude which guarantees their biological variety and productiveness and vitality, is but one measure put in place to secure the preservation of the natural gem. Time-lapse photography and breath-taking shots show our main protagonist – the woods – in its stunning glory. This beautiful wooded land, changes throughout the seasons. Our woodland is a world-renowned ecological jewel. It is famous, well-known and loved by tourists, forest economists, environmentalists, historians and intellectuals alike.

programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers
programme.desc: The Gironde is the largest and most powerful tidal current in Europe. When the Gironde flows into the Atlantic, it is 15 kilometers wide and in the rhythm of the tides, it brings the waters from the Pyrenees and the Massif Central into the ocean. This often pushes its waters far out into the Gironde at high tide.This creates a world of its own that has shaped everything uniquely and intensely for tens of thousands of years. The water surface of the river is so large that the evaporation has created its own microclimate, which is stable and, together with the brackish waters, has influenced flora and fauna on the right and left of the bank for a long time.

programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers
programme.desc: The Dordogne consists of a visible and an invisible system of flowing water. Caves and basins under the earth's surface store the excess water and return it to the river when it is dry. A perfect management of a precious resource, not invented by humans, but by the complex nature itself. The result is an ever life-giving river.

Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Ein dreckiges Labor und ein Urlaub führen zur Entdeckung unserer ersten wirksamen Waffe gegen Bakterien: Penicillin. Die Entschlossenheit eines Wissenschaftlers, die "falsche" Lösung zu testen, beschert uns einen besonders starken Kunststoff. Und aus einem nicht funktionierenden Laser wird die LED-Leuchte.

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Als der Schweizer Chemiker Albert Hofmann an einem Kreislaufmedikament forscht, entdeckt er zufällig LSD. Ein deutscher Chemiker hingegen will eigentlich einen Farbstoff herstellen, doch es entsteht hochexplosives TNT. Außerdem spielt ein mit Urin gefüllter Kühlschrank eine Rolle bei der Verbesserung der psychiatrischen Versorgung.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Wie können wir uns den Wind als mächtige Naturgewalt möglichst effizient zunutze machen? Einer der größten Windparks der Welt entsteht vor der englischen Küste, wo die rauen Bedingungen das Projekt vor große Herausforderungen stellen. Unterdessen strebt ein norwegisches Team danach, den allerersten schwimmenden Windpark zu bauen.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Schwebten 2010 noch weniger als 900 aktive Satelliten im Weltraum, so sind es heute fast 5000, und viele davon sind nur so groß wie ein Schuhkarton. Sogenannte "Satellitenschwärme" können uns mit wichtigen Daten versorgen - doch welche Gefahren bringen sie mit sich? Und wer wird den Kampf um die Vorherrschaft im All gewinnen?

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Auf der ganzen Welt zerbrechen sich Ingenieure und Wissenschaftler die Köpfe, um ein zentrales Problem zu lösen: Wie kann man Strom sicher und effizient in großem Maßstab und zu geringen Kosten speichern? Die Suche nach Antworten bringt einige wirklich bemerkenswerte Ideen hervor. Doch welche davon funktionieren auch in der Praxis?

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Das Baugewerbe ist für einen erschreckend hohen Prozentsatz des weltweiten Energieverbrauchs und der Treibhausgasemissionen verantwortlich und aktuell ist keine Trendwende in Sicht. Wie können wir in Zukunft umweltfreundlicher bauen und wohnen? Und welche Rolle könnten dabei Gebäude aus Holz spielen?

programme.title: Männer & Maschinen
programme.desc: Lexion 780 ist einer der modernsten und leistungsstärksten Mähdrescher der Welt.

programme.title: Männer & Maschinen
programme.desc: Er ist der König des unwegsamen Geländes, der Schreitbagger M545x.

programme.title: Die Schatzsucher von Ischia
programme.desc: Früher fuhren Giulio Lauro und sein Sohn Gaetano aufs Meer, um vor der Küste Ischias Fische zu fangen. Der Erlös reichte kaum zum Leben, das Geschäft lief mit der Zeit immer schlechter. Heute haben die Lauros keine Fische, sondern Touristen an Bord. Denn inzwischen spüren sie in der Bucht vor Ischia Ponte nicht Makrelen und Kalmare, sondern Artefakte der Antike auf.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Im Erzgebirge haben sich der Mountainbiker Christian und sein bester Freund Til vorgenommen, an zwei Tagen den Bikeman Trail zu bezwingen. Im Allgäu steht John am Abgrund - er testet beim Klippenspringen seinen Mut. Und beim Apnoetauchen im Blindsee erleben Felix und Max einen Tiefenrausch. 15 Meter wollen sie mit nur einem Atemzug bezwingen.

programme.title: Besser essen, länger leben?
programme.desc: Aktuelle Forschungsergebnisse weisen darauf hin, dass unsere Ernährung der wichtigste Faktor für anhaltende Gesundheit und ein langes Leben ist. Ärzte, Köche und Ernährungswissenschaftler zeigen, wie wir gesünder leben können, indem wir frische Zutaten in unsere täglichen Mahlzeiten einbauen - ohne dass der Geschmack dabei zu kurz kommt.

programme.title: Der Feinkost-Tempel von Bologna
programme.desc: Das gesamte kulinarische Angebot Italiens, gebündelt unter einem Dach - nicht weniger verheißt die "Fico Eataly World", die in Bologna ihre Tore geöffnet hat. Sechs Millionen Besucher will der weltweit größte Feinkost-Tempel jährlich anziehen. Doch die ortsansässigen kleineren Lebensmittelerzeuger fühlen sich durch die Marktmacht der Konkurrenz in ihrer Existenz bedroht.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Das New York City Fire Department ist stolz auf seinen guten Ruf und seine Geschichte. Die Berufsfeuerwehr ist weltweit führend in Sachen Innovation, aber sie ist auch von Tragödien geprägt. Durch gute Vorbereitung, Koordination und Einsatzbereitschaft macht das FDNY es für die New Yorker sicherer, New Yorker zu sein.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: New York City ist das Herzstück des amerikanischen Eisenbahnsystems. In seinem Zentrum steht das Grand Central Terminal. Der Bahnhof im Beaux-Arts-Stil zieht seit über hundert Jahren Touristen und Pendler gleichermaßen an. Doch um alles am Laufen zu halten, sind Hunderte von Schaffnern, Bahnhofsmanagern und Rettungskräften erforderlich.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: New York mag zwar das beste öffentliche Nahverkehrssystem Amerikas haben, aber seine Straßen sind genauso wichtig. Jeden Tag müssen sich dort Massen an Fußgängern, Radfahrern und Autofahrern miteinander arrangieren. Damit alles reibungslos funktioniert, braucht es Streumittel, Kehrmaschinen, Tausende von Kameras und jede Menge Asphalt.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: In New York fällt eine Menge Müll an - aber die Hälfte davon kann recycelt werden. Hier nimmt die Stadt auf vielfältige Art eine Vorreiterrolle ein: Von Anlagen, die Flaschen und Dosen verarbeiten, über eine neue Kompostierungsbewegung bis hin zu einer Gemeinschaft, die auf das Recyclingsystem angewiesen ist, um zu überleben.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Korrosion mit Coolnessfaktor: Auf dem Hof der Flying Classics landet eine Simson Schwalbe im Rost-Design. Die Porsche-Experten von 9elf verpassen dem frisch gestrahlten Carrera ein komplettes Check-up. In der Werkstatt von Il Motore wirkt strahlender Sand wahre Wunder. Motortausch für eine amerikanische Legende: In Tom's Roadhouse wartet ein Mustang auf seine neue Maschine.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Für den Carrera schlägt die Stunde der Wahrheit. Wird das edle Sammlerstück dem kritischen Prüfer-Blick standhalten? Der Il Motore-Chef jagt einen asiatischen Kultflitzer Marke Datsun auf den Leistungsstand. Geduldsprobe für den Vespa-Experten: Die Kupplung einer alten spanischen Vespa wird zum Problemfall. Auch die Montage des neuen Mustang-Motors wird zur kniffligen Herausforderung.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Das Team 9elf steigt um. Statt mit Porsche geben die PS-Experten im VW-Beetle Gas auf der Rennstrecke. Ein betagter Italiener muss sich beweisen. Läuft der bei Il Motore überholte Fiat-Motor problemlos? In Tom’s Roadhouse bekommt das Ford-Hot Rod seine Achsen zurück. Wird die Problem-Kupplung der spanischen Vespa nach furioser Feinarbeit der Flying Classics wieder funktionieren?

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Beim Team 9elf treffen die langersehnten Edel-Felgen ein. Die Flying Classics bringen eine blaue Schwalbe auf Vordermann. Die Fachkenntnis des Il Motore-Teams ist ausnahmsweise bei einem Flugzeug-Oldie gefragt. Auch der Ford aus den 30er Jahren steht bei Tom's Roadhouse vor einer speziellen Premiere: Jungfernfahrt mit einem Gang mehr.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: In einer Hamburger Werft liegt eine Hafenfähre zur Modernisierung. Das Schiff wurde dafür komplett entkernt. Ein halbes Jahr soll die Fähre in der Werft bleiben, dann soll sie wieder auf die Elbe. Schiffsbauer Melvin Ommer und Torben Groth bauen die generalüberholte Antriebsmaschine wieder ein. Gar nicht so einfach, denn das riesige Bauteil wiegt 1,5 Tonnen, und der Maschinenraum ist eng.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Ein Hotel in Rheinland-Pfalz hat einen besonders extravaganten Anbau in Auftrag gegeben. Ein Baumhaus auf Stelzen soll als neuer Konferenzraum dienen. Zimmerer, Dachdecker und Fensterbauer arbeiten auf engem Raum zusammen, um das klobige Holzhaus zu montieren. Die Bauteile sind schwer und die Männer arbeiten am Hang. Große Maschinen können sie deshalb kaum einsetzen.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: LKW-Pannenhelfer Stephan Lommatzsch bekommt einen seltenen Auftrag: Auf einer Schnellstraße ist ein Bagger beim Verladen auf den LKW umgekippt. Und solange das Fahrzeug auf der Straße liegt, muss die Straße gesperrt bleiben. Lommatzsch muss bei der Bergung sorgfältig arbeiten, und darf sich weder von genervten Autofahrern noch vom gestressten Chef der Baufirma aus der Ruhe bringen lassen.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Baustellen verlangen Arbeitern viel ab – besonders wenn es um Hochhäuser geht.

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Die erfolglose Suche nach einem sichereren Kühlmittel führt zur Erfindung von Teflon, eine beschädigte Lieferkiste zur Erfindung von Dynamit. Eine zufällige Begegnung zwischen dem Hollywoodstar Hedy Lamarr und einem Komponisten ebnet den Weg für WLAN - und Pawlows Hundeexperiment für unsere Handysucht.

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Ein fehlgeschlagenes Experiment beschert uns das wichtigste Werkzeug zur Verbrechensbekämpfung. Ständig reißende Arbeiterhosen führen zur Erfindung von Kunststoff. Ein zufälliges Gespräch und ein Wurstgift verändern das Gesicht Hollywoods für immer. Und ein kaputtes Thermometer setzt eine Kette von Ereignissen in Gang, die ein Land vom Kolonialismus befreien.

programme.title: Connections mit James Burke
programme.desc: Die Vision: Ein Quantencomputer, der so leistungsstark ist, dass er in der Lage sein wird, riesige Datenmengen zu verarbeiten und unsere Zukunft vorherzusagen. Doch um Computer und ihre Evolution besser zu verstehen, lohnt sich auch ein Blick in die Vergangenheit - denn dort warten einige unerwartete Zusammenhänge.

programme.title: Connections mit James Burke
programme.desc: Nanofabriken könnten alles herstellen, was wir uns wünschen, und das Atom für Atom - ein Haus, einen Apfel, Kleidung, Diamanten oder Kunstwerke. Doch bei genauer Betrachtung befinden wir uns bereits seit 200 Jahren auf der Reise hin zu dieser sensationellen Technologie, denn alles begann ausgerechnet mit einer Perücke von Ludwig XIV.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Strombetriebene Fahrzeuge sind immer verbreiteter und gelten als großer Hoffnungsträger, wenn es um einen klimafreundlicheren Personen- und Güterverkehr geht. Doch damit sie zur neuen Normalität werden können, gilt es noch so manche Hürden zu überwinden - sowohl in technischer Hinsicht als auch in unseren Köpfen.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: In the emotionally charged episode host Mike honors a deeply personal commitment to his late father, who passed away from cancer, to seek out the true meaning of happiness. Following this heartfelt promise, we venture to Bhutan, a remarkable country where happiness is not merely an emotion, but a national policy ingrained in its culture. From the lively capital of Thimphu to the peaceful farmlands of Punakha, we explore how Bhutan has seamlessly woven well-being into all aspects of life—from its education system that teaches happiness as a subject to its communities that prioritize collective well-being. This journey serves as both a tribute to Mike's father and an investigation into how Bhutan's unique approach to happiness could offer transformative insights for our own lives. Join us on this poignant and enlightening trip to the Land of the Thunder Dragon as we delve into what happiness truly means, fulfilling a promise and enriching our understanding of life's greatest pursuit.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E01 - Costa Rica
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore Zunya, an eco-village, and its enchanting blue zone concept. We delve into communal living, uncovering its allure. At La Senda, we experience soul cleansing Temazcal and a sublime cacao ceremony. We engage in a farm-to-table activity, savouring locally sourced ingredients. Cala Luna offers a rejuvenating body treatment amidst serene surroundings. We encounter the Maleku Tribes, witnessing their dance ceremony and visiting their cacao farm. The journey concludes with a breath taking hike and a majestic volcano view, reminding us of nature's beauty. This episode is a transformative adventure of self-discovery, cultural immersion, and connection with nature.

programme.title: Journey Within

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Iceland’s raw nature, good hearted people and vast open spaces encourage Scott and Justin to brave the elements. From Reykajavik the guys rent a 4x4 truck and hit the open roads, no matter what the conditions. They encounter a family while sheep herding, and join in to help on their way to find adventure in the ice and glaciers . Active volcanoes, ice climbing and squeezing into an underground lava tube hint towards some of the personal strength needed to continue their world adventures.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Scott and Justin ultimately find themselves in the midst of some of the most wild roads and dangerous animals on the planet. Sleeping in a tree-blind while lions walk directly under them or taking a walking safari is no match to the real situation with the people they meet. The guys experience a way of life that is so drastically different than theirs, impoverished and battling the HIV/AIDS epidemic, the guys witness the joy and sorrow at a small church ceremony and gain a fresh outlook from their new Zambian friends.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.sub-title: Historia do carro - Historia da BMW
programme.desc: Prazer de dirigir: A BMW, um dos grupos automotivos de maior sucesso do mundo, promete exatamente isso. Os carros e motos esportivos da Bavarian Motorenwerke AG são igualmente populares entre os clientes e nos esportes de corrida.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: É o Porsche "James Dean", a Spyder 550. É pequeno, plano e rápido. E foi construído apenas 140 vezes. Mas mesmo assim, a aranha Porsche 550 escreve a história. E é o carro em que a lenda de Hollywood, James Dean, morre em um acidente. A História Automotiva conta toda a história do carro dos sonhos dos anos 50.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Seja em Rallye, Circuito ou Indianápolis. Por mais de 100 anos, as corridas têm sido a força motriz da Ford. Os heróis daquela época são agora lendas.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: A BMW é um dos fabricantes de automóveis de maior sucesso no mundo. Desde o início, as corridas têm sido um dos principais componentes. E a transferência de tecnologia é uma grande vantagem, especialmente para os clientes.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Nos anos 80 e 90, a Porsche corre de vitória em vitória. Uma McLaren vence três vezes a Copa do Mundo de Fórmula 1 com a Porsche power. A Porsche de 1982 começa uma série de vitórias em Le Mans. As décadas de 1980, 1990 e 2000 são os anos dourados do automobilismo para a Porsche. A História Automotiva mostra os carros mais rápidos, as corridas mais emocionantes e os pilotos mais famosos.

programme.title: Glas 1700 GT
programme.desc: O Glas GT parece uma Ferrari, mas vem da província da Baixa Baviera, na Alemanha. No início dos anos 60, era um dos poucos carros esportivos alemães.

programme.title: Peugeot 205 Turbo 16
programme.desc: A Peugeot lançou este clássico, todo monstro de tração nas rodas com um único propósito: deveria trazer o Campeonato Mundial de Rally para a França. O Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 sacudiu o mundo do rali nos anos 80.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: As limusines britânicas são a encarnação do luxo, são irresistíveis e de tirar o fôlego e são a classe alta automotiva. Construídas com os materiais mais caros, as limusines britânicas como o Rolls Royce Phantom, Bentley Mulsanne ou Jaguar XJ combinam luxo atemporal, conforto único e potência superior. A DreamCars apresenta as mais exclusivas e caras limusines britânicas.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Seja o Mercedes Classe S, a série 7 da BMW ou o Audi A8, as limusines alemãs gozam de uma grande reputação de perfeição e prestígio. As limusines "Made in Germany" são consideradas personificações de um certo status e estabelecem padrões quando se trata de conforto, tecnologias pioneiras e segurança. A DreamCars apresenta as mais famosas, belas e luxuosas limusines alemãs.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: As limusines internacionais da Rolls Royce, Bentley, Mercedes, BMW e Jaguar garantem uma aparência exclusiva e significam status, prestígio e perfeição. Eles são os destaques das obras automotivas mundiais e a referência quando se trata de luxo magnífico e conforto elegante. DreamCars mostra as mais caras, mais luxuosas e exclusivas limusines do mundo.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: BMW M5, Mercedes-AMG E63, Audi RS6 e Mulsanne Speed, estas limusines de potência oferecem uma mistura única de estilo, desempenho e adequação para uso diário. Elas combinam o luxo das limusines com a dinâmica de um carro super esportivo. DreamCars apresenta as mais rápidas e excitantes limousines potentes do mundo.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: São obras-primas da arte automotiva, carros de uma elegância de tirar o fôlego, desempenho extraordinário, construídos para velocidades além da imaginação: Bugatti Chiron, Lykan Hypersports, Pagani Huayra e Ferrari LaFerrari.

programme.title: BMW Kelleners Sport 640i Grand Coupe
programme.desc: O Kelleners Sport 640i é baseado em um dos mais belos cupês de 4 portas. A empresa de tuning de Ralf Kelleners, filho de um tricampeão europeu de carros de turismo, fez nome ao se especializar na remodelação de BMWs.

programme.title: Volkswagen Touareg V6 TDI
programme.desc: A Volkswagen submeteu o Touareg a uma transformação radical. As esperanças são grandes: tem que vender em grande escala para que a administração possa restaurar a confiança das pessoas na marca Volkswagen.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O Tesla Modelo S foi o primeiro sedan premium do mundo que foi desenvolvido do zero como um carro elétrico. Tesla mostrou ao mundo que a eletromobilidade pode ser sexy e que ela funciona. Demos uma olhada mais de perto no Modelo S P85D.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O Coupé Classe S da Mercedes é uma verdadeira obra-prima. Exploramos o que o S 63 AMG Coupe tem a oferecer em comparação com o Bentley Continental e o Rolls Royce Wraith.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Com o Ghibli, a Maserati avançou para um segmento de mercado mais acessível. Mas a concorrência é forte. Além disso: levando o Maserati GranCabrio MC em um cruzeiro pelos Alpes.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O Aston Martin V12 Vantage S Roadster com seu motor V12 de 6 litros é provavelmente a exportação mais surpreendente do Reino Unido. Além disso: um cruzeiro de montanha da madrugada ao pôr-do-sol com o Corvette C7 Conversível.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O Porsche Cayman GT4 combinou os melhores elementos que a Porsche poderia oferecer. Além disso: o Audi R8 V10 plus, uma versão ainda mais forte, leve e rápida do modelo original.

programme.title: Rolls Royce Dawn Conversível
programme.desc: Quase silenciosamente, ele desliza pela noite. Diante do motorista, 12 cilindros de funcionamento suave estão em funcionamento, com uma reserva de energia que parece inesgotável. O Rolls Royce Dawn é um conversível para os conhecedores.

programme.title: Rolls-Royce Wraith
programme.desc: O Rolls Royce Wraith é diferente. Ele dá à marca britânica tradicional uma dinâmica totalmente nova.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Smart também ofereceu o seu icónico carro citadino com opção de descapotável. O Mini cabriolet é maior, não apenas debaixo do capô. Oferece espaço para quatro pessoas. Quando se trata de uma grande sensação de roadster, o Mazda MX-5 está no topo da lista. Demos uma vista de olhos mais atenta a estes três concorrentes de topo aberto.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: O Salão Automobilístico de Paris é o salão automobilístico mais antigo do mundo e dá uma visão do mundo automotivo. Em 2016, a Mercedes apresentou sua sub-marca "Generation EQ", e a Volkswagen anunciou a construção de 20 novos modelos eletrificados.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Para alguns, a forma de cupê tem um apelo mais sexy, mas por que alguém escolhe um cupê de duas portas como o Mercedes E400 em vez do CLS com quatro portas? Além disso: independentemente do preço diferente, a Volkswagen Arteon ainda desafia o CLS.

programme.title: Incrível Jaguar F-Type R Tuning: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: Um Jaguar que pode atacar o medo no mundo apenas com o seu rugido. Este Jaguar Arden-tuned F-Type R é um verdadeiro mau rapaz. Já tem uma verdadeira dentada na configuração padrão, mas o Arden é mais forte, mais alto e mais agressivo.

programme.title: Volvo S90
programme.desc: Parece mais esportivo do que se poderia esperar dos suecos. Os faróis traseiros emolduram a poderosa parte traseira. No interior, o Volvo S90 impressiona com os materiais mais finos e o couro macio da napa.

programme.title: Audi MTM S8 Talladega R
programme.desc: O Audi S8 Plus não é de forma alguma subestimado, mas é e permanece fiel à subestimação desta série de modelos. Aqueles que querem mais poder podem obter um impulso da MTM.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Em 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini teve como objetivo construir os melhores carros esportivos do mundo, um movimento ousado, estando localizado a poucos quilômetros da Ferrari. Apesar disso, seu primeiro modelo, o 350 GT, deixou a competição para trás.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: O nome da família Porsche está ligado ao projeto, fabricação e corrida de carros desde o início do século 20. Após a Segunda Guerra Mundial, a Ferry Porsche lançou as bases para os famosos modelos de carros esportivos da marca.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Não se pode falar em esportes de rali sem mencionar o nome Walter Röhrl. Desde jovem, Röhrl foi capaz de mostrar seu talento e venceu vários campeonatos europeus, mundiais e outros campeonatos internacionais de rali em sua carreira.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Hans-Joachim Stuck é um dos melhores pilotos de corridas da Alemanha. Durante sua carreira, ele não só ganhou a Fórmula II e vários campeonatos internacionais de carros de turismo várias vezes, mas também a corrida de Le Mans 24 horas duas vezes.

programme.title: Ford GT40 - Project 'Victory in Le Mans'
programme.desc: Com seus carros V8, a Ford mostrou que eles foram capazes de construir vencedores de corrida. O Ford GT40 foi um excelente exemplo para isso, especialmente em Le Mans.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Quando o fabricante britânico Land Rover decidiu terminar a sua produção do icónico Defensor após mais de 60 anos, era necessário determinar um sucessor. Visualmente, poderia ser modelado após o Discovery, cuja quinta geração é uma mistura de veículo todo-o-terreno e SUV de luxo. Também: o SsangYong Rexton, o Jeep Renegade e a nossa escolha dos 5 melhores veículos todo-o-terreno.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.sub-title: Alpina B5 Touring contra Jaguar XF Sportbrake
programme.desc: O Audi RS6 e o Mercedes E63 AMG são os dois melhores esportistas entre os vagões de estação. A BMW parece ter desistido da corrida, mas o afinador de alto desempenho Alpina surgiu com o B5 Twin Turbo, sua resposta baseada na BMW para a forte competição. Também: o ágil e confiável Skoda Octavia Combi. E: o Jaguar XF Sportbrake, um vagão de estação para individualistas.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Quem é o rei das caminhonetes fora da estrada? Os especialistas off-road da Delta 4x4 transformaram um Volkswagen Amarol em sua chamada Besta e desafiaram o especialista off-road da Toyota Alexander Wohlfarth em sua Toyota Hilux. Qual destas motorizadas 4x4 tem melhor preço em terrenos difíceis e ainda oferece adequação suficiente para o uso diário?

programme.title: Cadillac Escalade
programme.desc: O Cadillac Escalade a princípio parece um típico carro americano bastante carnudo, mas este luxuoso SUV é mais um gigante amável e gentil, que deve ser capaz de ganhar simpatia com sua clientela.

programme.title: Seat Alhambra
programme.desc: Embora o Seat Alhambra não pareça particularmente esportivo, mas quando testado por dois ciclistas profissionais, ele mostra que não deve ser subestimado.

programme.title: KIA Sorento
programme.desc: O Sorento é o principal veículo da linha de modelos da KIA. O fabricante coreano espera conquistar o mercado de SUV premium, oferecendo boa qualidade a um preço atrativo. O Sorento atende aos padrões de um veículo de primeira classe?

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Nos anos 70, os modelos W 114/115 da Mercedes ofereciam engenharia sólida a preços moderados, o que fez com que o sedan com estilo Paul Braq se tornasse o primeiro Mercedes para pessoas comuns. Também: um inconspícuo Volkswagen Beetle de 1972 com 90 cv que atingiu 180 km/h na Autobahn. E: um marco na história automotiva da época: o NSU RO 80 com um motor rotativo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Nos anos 50, o Tatra da Tchecoslováquia introduziu carros avançados, até mesmo pioneiros. A clientela era exclusiva, e é por isso que estes carros são muito raros hoje em dia. Encontramos o proprietário de um Tatra T87 de 1937.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O Porsche 911 Targa, com sua construção leve, é um carro icônico. Além disso: o Lotus Seven Twin Cam SS é mais um carro de corrida do que um carro de estrada. E: o Bentley Blower de 1930 e o Sunbeam Tiger Roadster.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O GTA da Ford Fairlane de 1967 na forma NASCAR. Além disso: O Chrysler 300 C de 1995 era o veículo de produção mais potente dos Estados Unidos. E: o Cadillac série 62 conversível de 1949 estabelece novos padrões em luxo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O Triumph 1800 Roadster de 1947 oferece espaço para 5 entusiastas do ar fresco. Mais: The Jog, o rally de carros clássico mais difícil da Europa. E: o Wolseley Stellite de 1919.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: No final dos anos 50, a Facel Vega Facellia foi projetada para competir com a Porsche e a Alfa Romeo e abrir um novo segmento de mercado para a jovem empresa francesa de carros de luxo.

programme.title: BMW M3 Test Drive - A BMW de maior sucesso de todos os tempos!
programme.desc: Nos anos 80, a BMW lançou um carro que tinha verdadeiros genes de corrida, o M3. Originalmente concebido como modelo de homologação para o Campeonato Alemão de Carros de Turismo, tornou-se num dos carros desportivos de estrada mais quentes do mundo.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Days of Thunder - um evento de 1/8 milhas onde todos podem testar a velocidade do seu carro ou motocicleta. Mas atingimos o local com um BMW X6 M de Haman com mais de 600 cv.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Já na oitava temporada da German Race Wars, visitantes de mais de 20 países fazem uma peregrinação ao mega-evento. E: O Mini John Cooper Works é a versão de corrida do piloto bávaro. Arden o transforma no Arden Mini AM 3.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Para a BMW tuner Manhart Racing, o Nürburgring Nordschleife é o lugar ideal para comemorar seu 25º aniversário. Como parte dos Track Days, clientes e partes interessadas têm a oportunidade de conhecer os modelos Manhart.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Uma vez por ano, os fãs de afinação de carros de todo o país se encontram no Neue Messe Dresden para o XS Carnight. Em 35.000 metros quadrados há sonhos de carros a serem vistos aqui enquanto as luzes se apagam do lado de fora.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Ao contrário das inúmeras reuniões do carro Show & Shine, no Rust'n'Roll quanto mais velho melhor. Somente quando os veículos parecem realmente velhos e enferrujados, são considerados bonitos.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: A NitrolympX é um evento esportivo motorizado que foi realizado pela primeira vez em Hockenheim, em 1986. Com cerca de 30.000 espectadores e cerca de 300 participantes, é o maior evento internacional de drag race da Europa.

programme.title: Um Fusca afinado!
programme.desc: Parece um Volkswagen Fusca dos anos setenta. Mas com afinação contemporânea, potência de 90 cavalos e velocidade máxima de 112 mph, promete prazer de dirigir sem limites.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: A BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS e Porsche Cayenne Turbo estão entre os SUVs mais fortes e rápidos do mundo. Os veículos utilitários esportivos fabricados na Alemanha são a encarnação da perfeição técnica, desempenho superior e conforto único. Na estrada, eles se sentem como um carro esportivo e ao mesmo tempo são capazes de dominar cada obstáculo em terreno aberto como um off-roader. A DreamCars apresenta os utilitários esportivos alemães mais caros, exclusivos e rápidos.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Luxo, estilo de vida e exclusividade, nenhum outro carro transporta estes atributos melhor que os SUVs da Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo e Infinity. Seja a elegância britânica, o design sueco moderno e reduzido ou o visual japonês esportivo, estes SUVs elegantes e excelentemente equipados incorporam um espírito de aventura e um gosto pela vida. A DreamCars apresenta os SUVs mais caros e exclusivos do mundo como o Bentley Bentayga, o Volvo XC90 ou o Infinity QX70.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Eles representam o estilo de vida americano mais do que qualquer outro carro, utilitários esportivos americanos e caminhonetes. Eles são extremamente grandes, extremamente poderosos e extremamente luxuosos e transportam a sensação de possibilidades ilimitadas e de aventura. Seja o Cadillac Escalade, Chevrolet Tahoe, Ford Raptor ou Dodge Ram, a DreamCars apresenta os mais espetaculares e mais potentes SUVs e caminhonetes americanas.

programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10
programme.desc: O Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 tem suas origens no exército japonês. Sua forma não ganhará nenhum concurso de beleza nem alcançará os melhores resultados no túnel de vento, mas este não é realmente o ponto com um SUV como este.

programme.title: Ford GT40 - Project 'Victory in Le Mans'
programme.desc: Com seus carros V8, a Ford mostrou que eles foram capazes de construir vencedores de corrida. O Ford GT40 foi um excelente exemplo para isso, especialmente em Le Mans.

programme.title: Aston Martin Rapide S - Novas Formas
programme.desc: Desde que a Aston Martin se tornou o carro da empresa de James Bond, a marca tem alcançado o estatuto de culto. Mas a venerável marca britânica também não está a fugir à evolução - porque com o Rapide S, Aston Martin está a desbravar novos caminhos.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Que alegria é quando a elegância encontra um desempenho extraordinário! O Maserati Quattroporte, o Kelleners BMW GranCoupe e o 911 4S da Porsche. Demos uma vista de olhos mais atenta a estes excelentes exemplos de poder combinados com estilo.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: Special: 24h of Le Mans - Test Days
programme.desc: Duas semanas antes do início das famosas 24 horas da corrida de Le Mans, todas as equipas estão ocupadas a testar os seus carros na pista tradicional de longa distância em França, com mau tempo, com acidentes e muita tensão.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O Porsche 911 mostra uma modéstia estilística como nenhum outro carro desportivo. Não se vangloria e evita qualquer aparência ruidosa. Explorámos a história por detrás deste icónico carro desportivo. Para além disso: O 911 Turbo S da Porsche.

programme.title: Secretária
programme.desc: A deturpada história do amor nada convencional que acontece entre um advogado perfeccionista e sua secretária neurótica.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 126: Cartas Interceptadas, Amor Confesado, Herencia
programme.desc: Marisela le dice Gabriel cuando este llega a la “suite” que no quiere verlo más. Gabriel le muestra las cartas que fueron interceptadas por Isadora hace veinte años. Marisela reconoce su letra en las cartas. Mientras tanto en otra habitación de ese mismo hotel, Isadora, Jesús y Braulio se disputan el dinero y los bienes de la herencia que dejó Alfonso Malavé. En otro lugar, Víctor Manuel le confiesa a Susy que se ha enamorado de otra mujer. Susy, curiosa de quién puede ser comienza a indagar y finalmente descubre que es de Yolanda de quién se enamoró. Víctor Manuel le confirma sus sospechas. Susy le dice que él se ha buscado una señora porque tiene un trauma de cuando su mamá lo abandonó.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 169: Paco Propone Matrimonio a Maria Antonia
programme.desc: Paco consigue acercarse a Gerson. Eglee asegura a María Gracia que un hombre es incapaz de dejar a una mujer. Paco le pide matrimonio a María Antonia

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 114: Ines y la nueva casa
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo le recrimina a Betania tras haber descuidado la vigilancia de Inés al percatarse de su ausencia. Robert le da la bienvenida a Inés a su nueva casa tras haberla sacado sin previo aviso de la casa de los Nuñez. Michelle y Daniela recorren su nueva casa esperando con ello ocultar la realidad de su verdadera situación económica, Michelle ignora las preguntas de Daniela con respecto a Flavia informando a su hermana de la disputa acontecida entre Berta y ella tras haberse asegurado de la aparición de la hija de Flavia.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo e Irene tienen una conversación muy seria después de lo que pasó en la empresa. Esa noche, tras regresar de la clínica, donde Irene cuidó a su madre todo el día, Agustina increpa a Leonardo y le recrimina no haberle avisado que no vendría a cenar y que tampoco se haya preocupado por sus hijos. Ya en su dormitorio, Leonardo e Irene hacen el amor por primera vez. Rodrigo y Alejandra se encuentran en un bar. Ella lo desprecia, pero él insiste en que ella finalmente caerá en sus brazos. Esa noche, Rodrigo se acuesta con Altaír. Sin embargo, su marido acusa a Carlos, en su propia casa, de ser el amante.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Cuando Alejandro y Sol comienzan a entablar una buena relación llegan las malas noticias y Sol debe irse a su pueblo. Raúla aparece en la ciudad alertada por Heriberto Madroño que le reveló que Reina fue quién envió a matar a los padres de Sol. Raúla se enfrenta a Reina y le pregunta sobre la verdad, Reina admite todo y la amenaza diciendo que si ella y Sol no se vuelven a Palo Colorado también las matará. Alentados por Bárbara, Giselle y Torombolo finalmente se convierten en novios.

programme.desc: Asesinan a dos reclusas en la cárcel donde está Virginia. Jimena se entera de esto y va a la cárcel, junto con Carlos Ernesto, quién la sigue, y ella termina confesando que recibió una llamada de alguien que ofrecía asesinar a Virginia. La directora de la cárcel termina deteniendo a Jimena. Felipe va a la casa de los Ferrándiz para avisarle a Irene de lo sucedido en la cárcel y Agustina sorprende a Felipe y a Irene abrazándose. La acusa con Leandro, pero este toma partido por Irene y echa de la casa a Agustina. Ella le pide ayuda a su sobrino Leo ofreciéndole a cambio revelarle un secreto familiar.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Columba y Raúla discuten acerca de la escapada de Sol con Alejandro. Mientras tanto, Sol y Alejandro se besan en un lugar remoto. Sol lo rechaza delicadamente y Alejandro decide que deben volver y respetar la decisión de ella. Don Eloy le informa a Maricielo que ha pagado la deuda y que la casa donde vive su familia ahora le pertenece. Alicia va a provocar a Carlos a su estudio y luego lo lleva hasta la prisión donde él le informa a su madre que saldrá en libertad.

programme.desc: Em uma pequena comunidade abalada por um recente acidente fatal em sua mina, o desaparecimento de um adolescente une um mineiro que sobreviveu à tragédia, a esposa de um gerente de mina e um garoto taciturno cheio de segredos.

programme.title: Federal
programme.desc: O Delegado Vital e o agente Dani estão à frente de uma operação do Comando de Operações Táticas da Polícia Federal do Brasil para capturar o playboy brasiliense Carlos Beque, envolvido com o tráfico internacional de cocaína.

programme.title: Enquanto ela esta Fora
programme.desc: Uma mulher que está fazendo compras na véspera de Natal até tarde da noite é logo aterrorizada por um pequeno grupo de arruaceiros e precisa lutar por sua vida.

programme.title: Frente à Frente
programme.desc: Cheung Sung-bong é um oficial da Unidade Regional de Crime que trabalhou na frente durante muitos anos. O seu protegido, Yau Kong-ngo, respeita-o e consegue chegar até ele. No entanto, o destino coloca-os uns contra os outros.

programme.title: Hitman - O Rei dos Assassinos
programme.desc: Um antigo chefe da máfia japonesa suspeita de ser vítima de um ataque e deixa uma recompensa para a pessoa que encontrar o seu assassino. Então, um assassino contratado e um golpista decidem juntos buscar o enigmático "Rei dos Assassinos " e ganhar o prêmio cobiçado.

programme.title: Xeque-Mate
programme.desc: Slevin Kelevra (Josh Hartnett) está com vários problemas em sua vida. O prédio onde mora foi condenado, sua carteira de identidade foi roubada e ele recentemente flagrou sua namorada na cama com outro homem. Para escapar ao menos por algum tempo dos problemas, ele consegue emprestado com seu amigo Nick Fisher (Sam Jaeger) um apartamento em Nova York. Paralelamente um plano está sendo tramado no submundo do crime de Nova York. Para se vingar da morte de seu filho, o Chefe (Morgan Freeman) planeja um golpe no filho de seu arquiinimigo, o Rabino (Ben Kingsley). O Chefe contrata Goodkat (Bruce Willis) para executar o plano, que consiste em encontrar um apostador que deva muito dinheiro ao Chefe a ponto de aceitar matar o filho do Rabino para se livrar da dívida. O escolhido é Nick Fisher, o que faz com que Goodkat vá até seu apartamento e confunda Slevin com seu alvo.

Quando Carol (Cate Blanchett) e Teresa (Mia Wasikowska) se apaixonam, o marido de Carol inicia o processo para obter a custódia total de seu filho. programme.desc: Um professor universitário alcoólatra em recuperação conhece uma nova aluna sedutora. Ela oferece a ele uma fuga sensual da realidade até que ele perceba que ela pode ser louca.

programme.desc: Adriana, uma escritora bem-sucedida, segue feliz em seu romance com André, que está prestes a lançar sua mais nova coleção de moda durante um cruzeiro pelo Caribe. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.
